reason: Include actual cable drag, PCB connector strain relief, and output-voltage slew in the representative joint bench. Preserve existing V9 sag and dynamic plan.

quasistatic_cable_drag.measure: Disconnect power and unload the joint mechanically; compare the same joint bare and with the proposed harness. Use a force gauge applied tangentially at a measured perpendicular lever arm. Do not infer cable torque from Present Current.
conditions: Increasing angle and decreasing angle, same slow speed
Full allowed range, in 5deg steps initially; inspect between steps near guides
3 cycles for screening; this is not a flex-life qualification
Record actual conductor count, insulation OD, cable construction, free length, endpoint orientation and guide geometry
quasistatic_cable_drag.compute: cable torque(q,direction) = measured harness force*r_perp - bare-joint force*r_perp; keep both signed traces and their hysteresis.
quasistatic_cable_drag.example_resolution: 0.1N at50mm corresponds to0.005Nm; choose instrument resolution after inspecting the small-servo torque budget, do not treat this example as achieved accuracy.
observe: Terminal motion, housing pull or loose latch
quasistatic_cable_drag.model_use: Measured drag/hysteresis is a separate joint load. Add it to gravity, inertia, friction and drive-limits before judging real-time tracking. A geometric loop passing CAD clearance is insufficient.
